payload.title: MPT Core Length Comparison
payload.description: This workflow analyzes the core length and timing of the Mid-Pleistocene Transition (MPT) using isotopic data. It involves importing and processing datasets from PANGAEA and other sources to compare core lengths and isotopic variations across different ocean drilling sites.

steps.description: Import necessary Python libraries for data manipulation, visualization, and analysis. Suppress warnings for presentation purposes.
steps.title: Import Libraries and Suppress Warnings

steps.description: Define group lists for easy loading of LR04 core data. Process the data to extract time and isotopic values, excluding discontinuities.
steps.title: Load and Process LR04 Core Data (Full)

steps.description: Define group lists for easy loading of sliced LR04 core data. Process the data similarly to the full dataset, focusing on specific time slices.
steps.title: Load and Process LR04 Core Data (Sliced)
